description: This file defines the React functional component 'NodeCard' which displays detailed information about an agent node, including health status, MCP info, and control buttons for starting, stopping, and reconciling agents. It includes UI rendering, state management, and interaction handling.

methods.name: highlightText
methods.description: Highlights search query matches within a string by wrapping matched substrings in a mark element.

methods.name: formatTimeAgo
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a human-readable relative time string.

methods.name: getMCPHealthStatus
methods.description: Determines the MCP health status based on the node's MCP summary, with null/undefined checks.

methods.name: getStatusText
methods.description: Returns the label for the node's presentation status for accessibility.

methods.name: handleNavigation
methods.description: Navigates to the node's detail page when the card is clicked.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles keyboard events for accessibility, initiating navigation on Enter or Space key.

methods.name: handleStartAgent
methods.description: Initiates starting the agent pool, with loading state management.

methods.name: handleStopAgent
methods.description: Initiates stopping the agent pool, with loading state management.

methods.name: handleReconcileAgent
methods.description: Reconciles the agent pool, with loading state management.

methods.name: getAgentState
methods.description: Determines the current agent control button state based on various statuses.

methods.name: handleAgentAction
methods.description: General handler to perform start/stop/reconcile actions on agents.
